title: VITABBORRE bowl
description: VITABBORRE bowl, blue, 6 ¼" Maybe something for the first home? VITABBORRE bowl is great for everyday meals and parties. Made of BPA-free plastic that’s both microwave and dishwasher safe, just like the matching plates and glass. Available in 2 colors ─ mix and match as you like.
features: If you want to heat food in the microwave, a bowl or plate made of glass or porcelain is preferable since some food can quickly reach temperatures above 212 °F, which can cause plastic to melt.
Wash this product before using it for the first time.
